name: AlIcE
source:
"A long time ago, there was a famous family,
but that famous family disappeared due to an incident.
I don't know where they are now.
There are rumors that if you get lost in the mansion, you will never be able to come back."

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/78]NovelGame[/url]]
